_comment: Source of truth for the Page 1 central registry table in Asana Knowledge. Exists because Asana's page_get API can never read a <table>'s content back (only a placeholder line) — so the table's real rows must live here, not be reconstructed from Asana. Every asana-skill-changelog run must: 1) fetch the latest copy of this file from GitHub, 2) upsert this skill's row here, 3) render the FULL table from every row here and page_update Page 1 with it, 4) commit+push this file back to GitHub so the next run (possibly a different session) has the current full state. Never write a partial table to Page 1 from a stale copy of this file.

rows.what_it_does: แปลง requirement เป็น prototype พร้อม presentation mode — Asana-backed sibling ของ ds-governance-prototype-notion, Core DS เป็น base เสมอ, เลือก project-layer mode ได้ 3 แบบ (Core only / Existing project DS / Core + new composed layer), รองรับ compare toggle อิสระ 3 ตัว (Design System / Branding / Tone of Voice)
rows.output: Artifact (HTML prototype พร้อม presentation mode) + Asana Page 2/3 log
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat

rows.what_it_does: Logs a brand-identity knowledge source (Figma guideline, vendor deck, meeting notes) into Asana Knowledge as an index row + adaptive full source page — extracts real content, never guesses from filename
rows.output: Index row (Branding Guideline) + adaptive source detail page
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat

rows.what_it_does: Logs a copywriting/UX-writing guideline source into Asana Knowledge as an index row + adaptive source page, preserving bilingual Thai/English examples verbatim
rows.output: Index row (Copy Writing Guideline table) + adaptive source detail page
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat

rows.what_it_does: Captures an external reference (web link or Asana page) into the Design Knowledge tree — walks the tree, merges into an existing page or creates a new one, writes content in Thai
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat

rows.what_it_does: Logs a UX research report into Asana Knowledge as an index row + adaptive report page shaped to the research type; flags mock/placeholder studies
rows.output: Research index row + adaptive report page
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat

rows.what_it_does: Logs a skill's version update into Asana Knowledge as a 3-page structure (central registry row, per-skill page, per-version detail)
rows.output: Registry row + Page 2 (usage/changelog) + Page 3 (version detail) per logged skill
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat

rows.what_it_does: Audits a Figma screen against Core + project DS, classifies findings as Existing DS Issue (annotation only) or Design System Gap (annotation + Asana task)
rows.output: Figma Dev Mode annotations + Asana tasks (Gaps only) in 📋 Component issue project
rows.author: Ticha Hongsongkiat
